welcome: 📬 Welcome to MailHub All your mail in Telegram. Connect Gmail or Yandex and get new-mail alerts right here. Choose an action below
main_menu: 📬 Main menu What would you like to do? Open the Mini App with the button beside the message field.
input_placeholder: Write a message or choose an action
choose_provider: ➕ Connect an account Choose your mail provider:
auth_instructions: 🔗 Connect an account Open the link below and grant access. We use it to read mail and mark messages as read. The link expires in 10 minutes.
auth_link_sent: 🔗 Your authorization link is ready. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth_expired: ⚠️ This authorization link has expired. Start again.
account_connected: ✅ Account connected {email} was added. Initial mail is imported without a notification flood.
account_disconnected: ✅ Account {email} disconnected. Its MailHub messages were removed.
confirm_unlink: 🗑️ Disconnect account? {email} will stop syncing. This cannot be undone.
no_accounts: 📭 No connected accounts Add Gmail or Yandex to get started.
help: 📖 Help Connect mail 1. Tap “📬 My accounts” or “➕ Connect”. 2. Choose Gmail or Yandex. 3. Open the link and approve access. Read messages Open the Mini App with the button beside the message field or tap “📖 Open” in a notification. Mark as read Tap “✅ Mark as read” below a notification. The state is synced back to your mailbox. Mail is never sent on your behalf. Tokens are encrypted.
settings_hint: ⚙️ Settings Open the Mini App to change language and notification categories. Sync interval is automatic: 10 seconds to 5 minutes.
oauth_invalid_state: ⚠️ Invalid or expired authorization link. Start again from the bot.
account_deactivated: ⚠️ Account {email} was disabled after repeated sync errors. Reconnect it.
error_generic: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again.
